questions.q: From what age do you take children?
questions.a: From three months to school age, in three rooms.
Yes, for months when a room is full. Pick your child's age above to see the next place.

questions.q: Do you offer the funded hours?
questions.a: Yes, the 15 and 30 hours, stretched across the year. Nothing extra is a condition of them.

questions.q: Will my child go outside every day?
questions.a: Yes, every room, every day, in all weathers. We keep spare waterproofs.

questions.q: Can I bring a packed lunch?
questions.a: Yes. Lunch is optional; many families send their own.

questions.q: What if my child has additional needs?
questions.a: Please message us before a visit: we'll talk it through with you.

blocks.heading: How we work
blocks.body:
Sample: we follow the Early Years Foundation Stage, through play and real materials: clay, water, wood, paint, the garden.

Each child has a key person who knows how they learn and tells you what they've been doing.

blocks.heading: Settling in: what helps
blocks.body:
Sample article: a short, cheerful goodbye helps more than a long one. Tell your child when you'll be back, in words they know: after lunch, after sleep.

The first week is usually the hardest; most children are settled by the second.

blocks.heading: What children learn through play
blocks.body:
Sample article: pouring water from one jug to another is maths, and physics, and patience.

When a child asks to do it again, that's the learning.
